source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"To replace the preprocedure time-out and site verification because only one structured team communication step is needed for surgery.","B":"To identify one person to blame for any difficulty so the team can close the case without reviewing process or system opportunities.","C":"To document that the case ended on time, without discussing safety concerns, communication failures, equipment issues or improvement opportunities.","D":"To review what happened, identify concerns and lessons, recognize successes, and agree on improvements that can strengthen future team performance."}}
source_row.rationale: A debrief is a structured post-event review of team performance, concerns, successes and lessons with the purpose of improving future performance; it does not replace the procedural time-out.
source_row.source_detail: TeamSTEPPS debrief tool: a short information exchange after an event designed to improve team effectiveness by reviewing performance, identifying what went well and what should change. Current AHRQ TeamSTEPPS 3.0 debrief tool rechecked 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.
source_row.stem: What is the primary purpose of a structured post-procedure team debrief?
